channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A new roadmap and requirements were documented for the upcoming version, and the backup system was updated to support a tiered storage model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An outdated AI component was removed and its documentation cleaned up, and storage management was enhanced to retain important markers during cleanup. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor tools were expanded with lockout scenarios, CSV output and better formatting, and the SDK added a payout address feature and a numeric keypad component, alongside various fixes. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The network milestone audit was completed and documentation updated, while new features added payout address retrieval and idempotency handling, and the wallet now shows real job counts. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: User authentication was strengthened by hashing passwords and adding rotating refresh tokens, and the system now supports registering services dynamically. The dashboard received design updates for accessibility, and build processes were adjusted to use internal build machines. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was improved to store hashed passwords and related tests were added. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
